Name: Configure Stripe Subscription Tiers
Description: Set up the Basic ($29/mo), Pro ($49/mo), and Enterprise ($99/mo) subscription tiers in the Stripe dashboard with their respective features and pricing.

Name: Implement Frontend Checkout Process
Description: Implement Stripe Elements for the checkout form matching app design, include a clear feature comparison table for each tier, add prominent checkout buttons, and implement a tooltip explaining plan changes.

Name: Update Pricing Page
Description: Update the application's pricing page to accurately reflect the new subscription tiers and their details.

Name: Build User Dashboard Subscription Features
Description: Develop the user dashboard to display current plan details and billing info, allow users to upgrade/downgrade/cancel subscriptions, provide access to invoices/payment history, enable payment method updates, and display real-time status notifications for changes or errors.

Name: Implement Backend Stripe API Integration
Description: Integrate Stripe's API on the backend to handle creating and managing subscriptions and processing payments for successful and failed transactions.

Name: Develop Webhook Handlers
Description: Set up and test webhook handlers for invoice.payment_succeeded (activate/continue subscription), invoice.payment_failed (notify user/update info/email notification), and customer.subscription.deleted (manage access rights/renewal options).

Name: Integrate Frontend with Backend API
Description: Connect the frontend components with the backend API to ensure subscription changes are reflected in real-time on the dashboard and implement clear error notifications for users.

Name: Create and Execute Test Plan
Description: Prepare a detailed test plan covering manual and automated tests for the entire subscription flow (sign-up to billing to management), including specific scenarios for payment failures and cancellations.

Name: Develop User Documentation and Support Materials
Description: Create a help section or FAQ covering common subscription issues and provide clear instructions for users on managing subscriptions, accessing invoices, and handling issues.

Name: Document Backend API and Webhooks
Description: Document the API endpoints and webhook event handlers to facilitate future maintenance and troubleshooting.
